passages.text: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
This is a song.
People sing this song on the Sabbath day.

passages.text: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High, to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
This is a song for the Sabbath day.
It is good to praise the LORD.
It is good to sing praises to Your name, O Most High.
We proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning.
We proclaim Your faithfulness at night.
We use the ten-stringed harp.
We use the melody of the lyre.
passages.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר לְי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ לְהַגִּ֣יד בַּבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְֽדֶּ֑ךָ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃ עֲ‍ֽלֵי־ עָ֭שׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־ נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and goodness.
The LORD does great deeds.
You, LORD, have made me glad by what You have done.
I rejoice because of the works of Your hands.
I sing for joy because of Your actions.
passages.original: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

passages.text: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
The LORD does mighty works.
The LORD’s works are wonderful.
The LORD’s thoughts are deep.
The LORD’s wisdom is beyond measure.
passages.original: מַה־ גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand, that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
passages.sermon:
A senseless man does not know this.
A fool does not understand this.
The wicked grow quickly like grass.
All evildoers flourish for a time.
God will destroy them forever.
passages.original: אִֽישׁ־ בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין אֶת־ זֹֽאת׃ בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־ עַֽד׃

passages.text: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is exalted.
The LORD is above all.
The LORD remains exalted forever.
The LORD never loses His greatness.
The LORD’s high position never ends.

passages.text: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
passages.sermon:
The LORD has enemies.
The LORD is God.
God’s enemies will perish.
All evildoers will be scattered.
passages.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God has power and authority.
God has lifted up my strength.
My strength is like the horn of a wild ox.
God has anointed me.
God used fresh oil to anoint me.
passages.original: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃

passages.text: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
passages.sermon:
I see my enemies fall.
I watch as those who rise against me are defeated.
I hear my wicked foes cry out in distress.
My eyes witness their downfall.
My ears listen to their wailing.
passages.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃

passages.text: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person will flourish.
The righteous will be like a palm tree.
The righteous will grow strong.
The righteous will be like a cedar tree in Lebanon.
passages.original: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
passages.sermon: The righteous are planted in the house of the LORD.\r\nThey grow in the presence of God.\r\nThey flourish in the courts of our God.
passages.original: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃

passages.text: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain, to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
passages.sermon:
The righteous will still bear fruit in old age.
They will remain healthy.
They will stay green and full of life.
They will proclaim that the LORD is upright.
The LORD is my Rock.
There is no unrighteousness in Him.
passages.original: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃ לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־ יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־ עֹלָתָה בּֽוֹ׃
